actions.name: finance_search
actions.summary: Search instruments by name or code across A-shares, Hong Kong, US and mutual funds. Use this whenever the user names a company instead of a code. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.

actions.name: finance_chart

actions.name: finance_watch
actions.summary: List, add, remove or regroup the watchlist, and manage watchlist groups. Writes to the user's watchlist. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["list","add","remove","move","create_group","delete_group"],"description":"What to do. Default list."},"symbol":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical symbol: A-shares sh600519 / sz000001, HK hk00700, US usAAPL, fund fund161725. A bare 6-digit code is accepted for A-shares."},"group":{"type":"string","description":"Group name."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_portfolio
actions.summary: Value the paper portfolio (holdings with market value, cost, unrealized and daily P&L) or list recent trades. Positions with a missing quote or FX rate are reported as incomplete rather than guessed. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["holdings","history"],"description":"Default holdings."},"account":{"type":"string","description":"Account name. Omit for the primary account."},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"Rows for history, 1..100. Default 20."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_trade
actions.summary: Record a simulated buy or sell in a paper account. Cross-currency trades lock the exchange rate at execution and fail when no rate is available. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["buy","sell"],"description":"Trade side."},"symbol":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical symbol: A-shares sh600519 / sz000001, HK hk00700, US usAAPL, fund fund161725. A bare 6-digit code is accepted for A-shares."},"quantity":{"type":"number","description":"Share/unit count, must be > 0."},"price":{"type":"number","description":"Execution price in the instrument currency. Defaults to the latest quote."},"account":{"type":"string","description":"Account name. Omit for the primary account."},"fee":{"type":"number","description":"Commission in the account currency (major units, e.g. 5.00)."}},"required":["action","symbol","quantity"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_account
actions.summary: List, create, rename, reset, archive or delete paper accounts, and record cash flows (deposit / withdrawal / dividend / interest / tax / fee / adjustment). Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["list","create","copy","rename","update","cashflow","reset","archive","unarchive","delete"],"description":"Default list."},"name":{"type":"string","description":"Account name (target, or new name for create/rename)."},"currency":{"type":"string","enum":["CNY","HKD","USD"],"description":"Account currency for create. actions.name: finance_alert
actions.summary: List, set, remove, enable or disable price alerts. Alerts are checked while quotes refresh in the foreground — this container has no background wake-up. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["list","set","remove","enable","disable"],"description":"Default list."},"symbol":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical symbol: A-shares sh600519 / sz000001, HK hk00700, US usAAPL, fund fund161725. actions.name: finance_financials
actions.summary: Fetch up to eight periods of key financial indicators (revenue, net profit, ROE, gross margin, EPS, BPS with YoY) plus the current P/E and P/B. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"symbol":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical symbol: A-shares sh600519 / sz000001, HK hk00700, US usAAPL, fund fund161725. A bare 6-digit code is accepted for A-shares."}},"required":["symbol"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_perf
actions.summary: Compute portfolio performance: total and annualized return, max drawdown, volatility, Sharpe and win rate. Refreshes quotes and records a daily snapshot first; drawdown/volatility/Sharpe need at least two daily snapshots. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"account":{"type":"string","description":"Account name. Omit for the primary account."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_diagnose
actions.summary: Score portfolio structure (0..100) and list risk flags such as over-concentration, too few holdings or an excessive cash ratio. Refuses to score when any quote or FX rate is missing. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"account":{"type":"string","description":"Account name. Omit for the primary account."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_dividend
actions.summary: Fetch the dividend and bonus-issue history for an A-share company. A-shares only. Market quotes are delayed and for simulation/research only — never place real trades or move real money.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"symbol":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical symbol: A-shares sh600519 / sz000001, HK hk00700, US usAAPL, fund fund161725. A bare 6-digit code is accepted for A-shares."}},"required":["symbol"],"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: finance_fundflow

actions.name: finance_sector
